fixedMacroDiagnostic.explanation: This bound applies only while the recorded rack-top groups remain fixed. W04 rows 6 and 7 each permit a two-high lying floor column; the bound accounts for that stacking rather than summing four individual footprints. Ancillary floor space and gaps are omitted. Reassigning rack-top cargo changes the premise, so this is not proof against the original PDF allocation.
